title: Add repo by pasting its GitHub URL
description: Repo manager and init wizard ask for owner and name separately. Accept a single field that takes owner/name or any GitHub URL (https, ssh, with .git or extra path).

title: Dedupe branch runs by workflow ID and skip Dependabot dynamic runs
description: git-green dedupes workflow runs by run name (run.GetName()). Dependabot Updates runs are named per-update (e.g. 'npm_and_yarn in /. for @hotwired/turbo, axios, ...'), so every run is unique and none collapse — ndlibrary/honeycomb shows ~100 rows under its branch section and issues one ListWorkflowJobs call per run each poll. Fix: key the dedupe on run.GetWorkflowID() (stable per workflow file) and skip runs with event 'dynamic' (Dependabot-generated).
close_reason: Deduped by workflow ID and dropped dynamic (Dependabot) runs; PR #27

value: GitHub push account is Skeyelab (not edahl_UND). Switch with: gh auth switch -u Skeyelab before git push.
